tha-ap437:1.1: Ucchukaṇḍika.] Nagare Bandhumatiyā dvārapālo ahos' ahaṃ / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ. // //
tha-ap437:2.1: Ucchukaṇḍikam ādāya buddhaseṭṭhass' adās' ahaṃ / pasannacitto sumano Vipassissa mahesino. // //
tha-ap437:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ ucchum adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ucchukaṇḍass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap437:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ucchukaṇḍiko thero i. g. a-ti.
